ablation.binding: a coupled transition contains couplingId plus withoutCouplingNext; disabling a coupling mechanically substitutes withoutCouplingNext for every transition bound to that coupling
ablation.eligibilityInputBinding: input is winner model only; selection_reference recomputes unablated and each disabled-coupling evaluation itself
ablation.eligibleAblation: selection_reference internally evaluates every declared coupling; exact frozen evaluator P3Success>=0.50; no caller evaluation row accepted
ablation.initialStateOrdering: all train/eval starts are canonicalized under the same disabledCoupling semantics used by that evaluation; normal-world tie order cannot leak caller array order into ablation training
selection: maximize number of scalar family drops >=0.05
maximize sorted descending scalar loss profile
canonical coupling ID only as final fallback when semantic effects are identical
ablation.tieFingerprint: sorted records of normal source semantic identity + canonical action ordinal + normal successor semantic identity + disabled successor semantic identity computed under that disabled-coupling world

antiGoodhart.cosmeticConsequence: S1 pass via exact future-behavior bisimulation
antiGoodhart.hiddenAuthorization: candidate model receives no policy identity and contains only state/action transition data
antiGoodhart.playerModelOverfit: P2 last-training-epoch success - P2 eval success <=0.25
antiGoodhart.rewardHacking: candidate model has no reward field and evaluator reward is protocol-owned
antiGoodhart.rngInflation: candidate gameplay representation has no RNG/wall-clock/environment transition input
antiGoodhart.stalling: mean same-state transition fraction across P2+P3 eval episodes <=0.25

buildManifest.input: exact three candidate model bytes, canonicalized by candidateId before tournament/evidence recomputation
buildManifest.presentationSeedAuthority: derived only after exact three models are fixed from their sorted state-ID/raw-label-invariant semantic model fingerprints
buildManifest.validation: Human runner canonicalizes exact three models by candidateId, recomputes complete manifest, and requires canonical equality before serving either arm

freshnessBoundary.freshnessDefinition: R7 candidate model bytes are first authored only after exact R7 protocol freeze and unanimous controlling pre-generation audit pass by fresh generator occurrences forbidden to read prior whole-product candidate payloads
freshnessBoundary.reason: R7 retains provenance isolation; fresh generators cannot deliberately copy excluded whole-product candidates

humanHoldout.armDifferenceOnly: build-manifest disabledCoupling: null for winner; exact selected coupling for ablation
humanHoldout.assignment: SHA256 rank of frozen assignment seed + enrollment ordinal 0..23; first 12 winner, remaining 12 ablation; each arm mapped to ordinal 0..11
humanHoldout.choiceBoundary: after 480000ms accumulated interaction-qualified mandatory play show protocol-owned compensation-neutral Stop now / Continue playing choice
humanHoldout.heartbeatRole: positive presence witness only; absence is not the sole loss detector; explicit presence-loss events clear continuity immediately
humanHoldout.mandatoryClock: interaction-qualified active play only: heartbeat is a presence witness and contributes zero time; explicit hidden/blur/pagehide presence-loss events immediately clear presence+interaction anchors; time accrues only between successive meaningful verified gameplay interactions with gap<=30000ms and recent valid foreground presence
humanHoldout.optionalActiveClock: same interaction-qualified law as mandatory phase; heartbeat alone contributes zero and explicit presence-loss immediately resets continuity
humanHoldout.primaryEndpointDerivation: choice==continue AND accumulated interaction-qualified active optional play time >=180000ms
humanHoldout.qualifyingInteraction: successful participant-initiated canonical gameplay action or protocol-owned Next round whose protocol-verified before/after states differ in frozen future-behavior semantic class; rejected/illegal requests and semantic no-ops contribute zero and clear the interaction anchor

humanRendererBoundary.actionPresentation: global stable protocol ordinal: canonical action aK is always shown as Action K+1; illegal actions are omitted without renumbering
humanRendererBoundary.conformanceLaw: validate every reachable view/action edge; reject candidate visible text/pixels/internal IDs; prove token mapping is protocol-owned and 32-start schedule is preserved
humanRendererBoundary.humanBuildGameplayAuthority: winner model, selected coupling, and presentation seed must come from recomputed R7 build manifest
humanRendererBoundary.observationPresentation: single protocol-owned blinded token derived from canonical observation-equivalence class; candidate does not author pixel arrays, geometry, text, CSS, media or assets
humanRendererBoundary.participantTokenMapping: protocol-owned permutation of 256 token IDs derived from fixed renderer domain + presentationSeed + enrollment ordinal
humanRendererBoundary.presentationSeed: SHA256(fixed domain + sorted semantic model fingerprints of all three fixed candidates)
humanRendererBoundary.sessionStartLaw: 32 exact eval starts; within-arm participant ordinal 0..11; episode index advances by stride 13 modulo 32
humanRendererBoundary.terminalLaw: terminal state exposes only protocol-owned Next round control

modelContract.observationClassCanonicalization: label-invariant protocol canonicalization against gameplay structure; raw numeric relabeling does not change behavioral evidence or semantic model fingerprint
modelContract.semanticModelFingerprint: state-ID, raw-observation-label, and context-array-order invariant canonical gameplay+observation-partition fingerprint

policyLaw.explorationRandomness: SHA256 deterministic float over policy+epoch+context+disabled-coupling-aware semantic start identity+step+visible Q key; candidateId/slot excluded
policyLaw.initialStateOrdering: canonicalized by semantic_state_identity under the exact disabledCoupling semantics being evaluated; caller array order has no authority

preGenerationAuditRequirements: observation-class-only schema/semantic closure; no candidate-authored visible pixel/text/media channel
raw observation-label permutation leaves behavioral evidence, semantic fingerprint, presentation seed and token mapping invariant
state-ID rename + context-array reorder invariance under normal and every disabled-coupling evaluation
R6 S8 duplicate-action co-observed-state counterexample remains closed
R6 ablation trainInitialStates order counterexample remains closed and matched ablation is invariant
P0 visible-state-only semantics and candidate-slot/candidateId behavioral invariance
selector accepts exact models only and internally derives evaluator evidence
ablation internally reevaluates every coupling and uses disabled-world-aware semantic ordering/fingerprint
build manifest is candidate-input-order invariant and binds presentationSeed plus source/evidence/arm identities
blinded renderer shows one protocol-owned token and cannot expose candidate pixels/text/state/coupling/candidate IDs
presentation seed derives from all three semantic fingerprints and is invariant to raw state/observation relabeling
focused visible idle cannot advance mandatory play or VOLUNTARY_CONTINUATION_3M
explicit visibilitychange:hidden, blur, and pagehide between heartbeat ticks clear interaction continuity
rejected/illegal/no-op/self-loop interactions do not accrue play or preserve anchor
phase-rejected gameplay requests cannot mutate session state
any two-compliant-implementation counterexample affecting winner, ablation, Human build, presentation, or endpoint terminates R7
researchQuestion: Can Ordivon autonomously create and select a fresh declarative finite-state whole-product game without live Human candidate-quality judgment before build freeze, then produce non-trivial voluntary continued play in a sealed Human holdout?

selection.candidateIdAuthority: identity plus final tournament tie-break only
selection.defeatRule: A defeats B iff A is >=0.05 better on at least two families and <=-0.05 worse on zero families
selection.evidenceDerivation: selection_reference.evaluate_authoritatively calls frozen evaluator_reference.evaluate_model from candidate model bytes
selection.humanBuildAuthority: build_manifest_reference.make_manifest recomputes tournament and matched ablation from exact candidate models
selection.reason: all three fresh candidates are implemented; no preimplementation rank is needed

S1.score: fraction of reachable >=2-action decision states whose legal actions lead to >=2 distinct exact future-behavior bisimulation classes

S4.diagnosticAliasing: same observation in multiple reachable states with different oracle first actions

S7.score: mean context-specific P1 diagonal success - mean cross-context off-diagonal success

S8.duplicateActionLaw: for each action pair enumerate reachable states where both are legal; compare successor exact future-behavior bisimulation class on the same state; if coObservedCount>0 and equivalent/coObserved>=0.95, pair is duplicate and S8 fails

S9.score: minimum P3 success across the four exact eval contexts
